_meta.what: Custom daily quests (operator's request, 2026-11-07): more variety and higher, varying rewards. Merged into daily_quests.json's catalogue by ffbe_player.daily_quest_catalogue when EXVIUS_DAILY_CUSTOM=1.
_meta.ids: 69xxxxx, a range the shipped tables don't use. The client draws a row's text from MST_DAILY_QUEST_NAME_<id> / MST_DAILY_QUEST_DETAIL_<id> (the list shows the DETAIL); ios_texts.py adds those rows to the iPhone's F_TEXT_DAILY_QUEST_NAME / _DETAIL.
_meta.rewards: Each quest names a reward tier. The day's reward is drawn from the tier's list by (day, quest id) and is the same all day. Lapis amounts are before EXVIUS_LAPIS_MULTIPLIER; the row shows the amount after it, which is what is paid. Gil is written kind:amount:amount (the client draws gil's amount from the id field). A unit reward may carry the native trust metadata (kind:id:count:100:level:points:target); the row only shows kind:id:count.
_meta.actions: Scored by ffbe_player.score_daily: story_clear / vortex_clear / exploration_clear / mission_clear (any quest) / no_ko_clear / lb_use / magic_use / esper_use on a cleared quest; trust_up (units that gained trust in a clear); level_up (unit levels gained in battle); unit_fuse; expedition_finish; arena_win; summon; friend_gift; gil_earn.
